                                                                                                                                            Felissa King
                                                                                                     4 years ago

                                                                                                    Lovely glaze!! The coloring is quite different with Spanish RIO
                                                                                              vs Red Natural. Spanish comes out much more orange and
                                                                                                            soft as shown above, Red Natural is a stronger red/brown.
                                                                                                   Just depends on your preference, I have students who like
                                                                                                each!



                                                                                                                          Robert Boyd
                                                                                                            2 years ago

Really nice stable glaze. Love the brown/orange breaking on
                                                                  edges.
                                                                           Fired on White Little Loafer clay at ^6 which had been bisque
                                                                                  fired to ^06. Specific Gravity is 1.45.



                                                                                                     Kari W
                                                                             2 years ago





                                                                       Hi Terry, this photo (attached) is showing as Nutmeg, but I've
                                                              seen that several have results that do not look anything like
                                                                                  this photo. Is this acheived with natural cooling at cone 6 (as
                                                            marked on the photo), or does this look require a specific
                                                                        cooling method?


                                                          From what I see in your results photos, the controlled cooling
                                                                          resulted in a much darker/ruddy color, but I'm after this
                                                                         yellow/orange/pink variegated look. It's so lovely!

                                                              Thanks for any thoughts. 🙂
